verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents some at-scale, multi-output operations of its own: the Localization API localizes a video into up to 20 languages in a single request, and the Video API is pitched as generating templated videos "at scale" with asynchronous jobs and webhook completion. There is no evidence of true bulk operations across many existing items, such as batch endpoints or bulk edit, delete or move in the workspace. missing for 10: documented batch/bulk API endpoints for creating many videos in one call, bulk management actions across many workspace items, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
